description: Read a project folder on this computer for launch mistakes that can't be seen from outside, before deploying: Row Level Security policies whose condition is just `true`, tables created without RLS, Supabase edge functions with verify_jwt = false, Stripe webhook handlers that never verify the signature, secrets behind a public prefix (VITE_, NEXT_PUBLIC_), a tracked .env file, and an agent config with a writable database connection. Pattern-based, not a full code review. Reads names in .env files, never values. Each finding has a fix prompt.

dir.description: The project folder. Defaults to the current folder.

name: greenlit_scan
